name: chess-glasses
description: INMO Air2 smart-glasses chess assistant: camera relay (WebRTC + JPEG fallback), OpenCV board reading and Stockfish hints (CS 536 bonus project).

scripts.gen-cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem -days 365 -subj /CN=glasses-cam -addext subjectAltName=IP:$(ipconfig getifaddr en0),DNS:localhost
